prompt:
Workflow step: Use the fixed robot arm to pick up the test tube from shaking device and move it to capping device to unscrew the test tube cap.
Inspection timing: before this step
Inspection location: shaking device
What the inspection checks: Check whether there is a capped test tube containing colored liquid on shaking device.

A description of the inspection camera's photograph follows, written by someone who was not told what is being checked.

Description: A dark grey benchtop rack or rotator sits on a white surface against a pale wall. It has an upright end plate on the left and a horizontal bar running right, fitted with a row of about eight round black holder rings arranged in two staggered lines. A single conical centrifuge tube is held upright in one of the central rings, passing through the bar. The tube is uncapped, its lid open and tilted back at the top, and it is filled roughly two-thirds with a red-pink liquid; graduation marks are visible along its side, and the pointed tip hangs below the bar. A white label with a black square symbol is mounted on the right end. A teal and white control panel is on the base below.
observations: The test tube on the shaking device is uncapped, with its lid open and tilted back, which fails the requirement for a capped test tube.
